events.text: The boundary index audit caught the shared-index hazard again: the wrapper swept unrelated peer inbox/roadmap/task paths into the disposable index despite explicit pathspecs. I’m abandoning that index and will construct the commit with direct blob/cacheinfo entries and a CAS commit-tree, so no unrelated ledger state can be published.

The direct cacheinfo rebuild is slower than the wrapper because it hashes each ledger file individually, but it is isolated from the poisoned shared index. No files are being mutated; I’m waiting for its exact staged-path report before committing.
